==Behind the scenes==
Arcania Prime was mentioned in all capital letters in the "Galactically-huge Word Finder!!!" segment of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.34|thirty-fourth issue of the sixth volume]] of the [[Star Wars Comic|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Comic]] magazine, which was published by [[Titan Magazines]]<ref name="TCWC" /> around [[May 31]], [[2012]].<ref name="Date">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.33|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Comic 6.33]]</ref>
